summary: This is a short note on the 1965 Italian tragicomedy film Questa volta parliamo di uomini, directed by Lina Wertmüller. It stars Nino Manfredi and was shot in black and white on 35mm film. The note gives its running time of 91 minutes.
one_line: A 1965 Italian tragicomedy film directed by Lina Wertmüller and starring Nino Manfredi, shot in black and white.
key_facts: Questa volta parliamo di uomini is also known in English as This Time Let's Talk about Men or Let's Talk About Men.
Questa volta parliamo di uomini is a 1965 Italian tragicomedy film.
Questa volta parliamo di uomini was directed by Lina Wertmüller.
Questa volta parliamo di uomini stars Nino Manfredi.
Questa volta parliamo di uomini was shot in black and white.
Questa volta parliamo di uomini was shot in 35mm.
Questa volta parliamo di uomini lasted 91 minutes.
